summary:
SF Italianate painted lady on a 16x50 lot: a teal-siding false front over a dark-teal garage base, with a full-height angled bay (x1..6) and a cream stair rising to a recessed columned porch (x10..14). Gold fish-scale bands, a burgundy frieze and a deep bracketed cream cornice sit under a pedimented parapet that hides a low `shop`-preset gable.
Ochre and pale-blue neighbours press against both sides. A lightwell lights the dining room and bath, one long staircase runs up the east party wall, and the kitchen opens onto a deck above a deep garden with a citrus tree, a veg bed and a bench.

rooms.purpose: Bright old-house kitchen at the back: range (smoker) with a hood, sink under the back window, barrel counters, pantry, small table; opens to the deck.
rooms.ways_in: (7,5..6,25) from dining; (12,5..6,25) from the hall; deck door (7,5..6,30)

rooms.name: front bedroom
rooms.purpose: Main bedroom: double bed facing the bay, wardrobe, vanity, a reading chair in the bay alcove (x2..5 z6); calm and elegant.

rooms.name: sewing room
rooms.purpose: Tiny room over the porch: sewing table (loom), chair, plants at the front window; cosy.

rooms.name: upper hall
rooms.purpose: Narrow landing with a banister along the stairwell, linen chest, a picture, hanging lamp. Keep x13 z16..19 (stairs) clear.

rooms.name: bathroom
rooms.purpose: White and brass Victorian bath: clawfoot tub (2 water cauldrons end to end), sink, toilet, towel rack, a plant at the lightwell window.

rooms.name: back bedroom
rooms.purpose: Children's room over the garden: two beds, toy chest, desk; cheerful.

rooms.name: top-floor studio
rooms.purpose: Artist's studio under the roof, open to the rafters, with the bay alcove x2..5 z6: easel, worktable, daybed, plants in the bay; airy and bohemian.

rooms.name: top landing
rooms.purpose: Reading nook at the head of the stair: armchair by the lightwell window, bookshelves, a lamp. Keep the stairhole x13 z18..19 and the arrival (13,13,20) clear.

rooms.name: attic bedroom
rooms.purpose: Guest room under the back gable: single bed, trunk, washstand, sloped ceiling; quiet.

concept_subject: A narrow San Francisco Italianate 'painted lady' squeezed between neighbours on a street that climbs to the east, seen from the sidewalk. The house is 14 blocks wide and stands as a tall teal false front, about 20 blocks high. At street level a dark-teal base holds paired burgundy carriage doors with a glass transom. On the west half a full-height angled bay window, glazed on its front and both diagonal faces, rises from cream corbels over the doors to the roofline. On the east half a straight run of cream steps with white balustrades and two lantern-topped newel posts climbs to a recessed porch, framed by two cream columns and an arch, with a burgundy front door, sidelights, a transom and a hanging lantern. The horizontal teal plank siding is crossed by gold fish-scale shingle bands at each floor line. The tall narrow windows have cream sills and little pointed pediment hoods. Under the deep cream cornice runs a burgundy frieze with rows of cream brackets; the cornice wraps around the bay. Above it a false-front parapet with gold panels and a small cream pediment hides a low dark-slate gable roof with an iron crest and two brick chimneys on the party walls. A tiny front garden of roses, peonies, azaleas and lilac sits behind a black iron fence beside the stair. The neighbours' walls press tight on both sides: an ochre house downhill to the west and a pale-blue one uphill to the east. Out back, a gold fish-scale gable sits over a spruce deck off the kitchen with stairs down into a long garden: a brick path, flower borders, a flowering citrus tree, a kitchen bed of carrots and beets, a bench, a lamp post and tall wooden fences.
concept_size: 16 wide, 50 deep (house 14x24 plus front and back gardens), 20 tall: a garage base and 3 storeys under a false front
